database.source: production MariaDB dump captured by server-backup-core.timer

object_storage.strategy: rclone sync to current with changed and deleted objects retained in dated versions

restore_drill.database: restore latest dump into disposable MariaDB 10.11 and verify WordPress tables
restore_drill.object_storage: download a deterministic object twice from the independent backup and verify bytes

success_definition: A backup is healthy only after the latest scheduled restore drill succeeds.
